description: Position du trait de côte du littoral sableux de la Communauté d'Agglomération Royan Atlantique (CARA) entre 1999 et 2025 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Royan Atlantique. The coastline line is by definition a curve/line representing the intersection of land and sea in the case of an astronomical high tide of coefficient 120 and under normal weather conditions (no offshore wind, no atmospheric depression likely to raise sea level). Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Royan Atlantique. The portal shows the English title as "Position of the sandy coastline of the Communauté d'Agglomération Royan Atlantique (CARA) between 1999 and 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Royan Atlantique. Its keywords include zones-a-risque-naturel, trait-de-cote, littoral, environnement, geomorphologie. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHAPE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
